dedupe_keys.name: zindi kuyesera mwbtfreddy hand labelled pre and post cyclone freddy imagery of houses in blantyre malawi in xbd format

description: The Kuyesera AI Disaster Damage and Displacement Challenge on Zindi (December 2024 to February 2025) asked for models that locate houses and judge whether Cyclone Freddy damaged them. Contents: mwBTFreddy, a Malawi-specific test set in xBD format curated by the Kuyesera AI Lab, with hand-labelled pre-disaster imagery taken about six months before the cyclone and post-disaster imagery after landfall in March 2023 over Chilobwe on Soche Mountain in Blantyre; training uses the global xBD building damage data, and a spreadsheet lists schools and health facilities within 1 and 2 km of the damaged area. Participants had to add at least one Amazon Sustainability Data Initiative data set (for example climate, land cover or elevation). Producer: Kuyesera AI Lab via Zindi. Coverage: Chilobwe and Soche area, Blantyre, Malawi. Format and access: data archive and starter notebook from Zindi after joining. Licence: the pages read do not state a data licence; use follows the competition rules. Caveats: the six-month gap between pre- and post-event images adds change unrelated to the cyclone; the test area is small. Simulation uses: rapid building damage assessment after cyclones and floods, and exposure of schools and clinics near damaged areas. Related records: data-xbd-building-damage and case_study-malawi-restore-road-reconstruction-and-climate-risk-assessment-after-cyclone-freddy.
